text: とおあさに　なってる　から　およいでる　ひとも　おおいよ！

structure.jp: とおあさに　なってる　から
structure.en: because it's shallow a long way out

structure.jp: およいでる　ひとも

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: なってる is the shortened spoken form of なっている. It shows a state that is in place now. とおあさに　なってる = 'it is shallow a long way out'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because' or 'so'. とおあさに　なってる　から = 'because it's shallow a long way out'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. およいでる　ひと = 'people who are swimming'.
